subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Lethargic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Active**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lethargic"** means lacking energy or enthusiasm; sluggish and apathetic. (सुस्त)
 
 
• **Example:** After the long journey, he felt lethargic and just wanted to sleep.
 
 
 
• **"Active"** refers to being energetic, lively, and full of movement or action. (सक्रिय)
 
 
• **Example:** She is very active and participates in various sports activities every day.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'lethargic'** is **'active'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Active**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Intelligent** (बुद्धिमान): Having or showing intelligence, especially of a high level.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very intelligent and always tops her class.
 
 
 
• **Cute** (प्यारा): Attractive in a pretty or endearing way.
 
 
• **Example:** The puppy is so cute that everyone wants to pet it.
 
 
 
• **Exhausted** (थका हुआ): Extremely tired and lacking energy.
 
 
• **Example:** After running the marathon, he was completely exhausted.
 
 

3c:Ta42,

The correct answer is: Option 3<
